text:
Maria: Quick heads-up — opened PR #4821 to patch a kv-batcher zero-length input bug. It's a small hotfix but touches a hotpath; would appreciate fast eyes. Plan to merge in ~45m unless objections. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4821 :eyes:
AJ: Can this trigger any perf regression on the high-throughput paths? Any numbers yet?
Maria: Did a quick microbenchmark on a small node: p50 basically unchanged, p99 +0.2ms in a worst-case synthetic run. I'll attach the CSV to the PR. Quick snippet from the run: `latency_before=[10.2,10.7,11.1] latency_after=[10.3,10.9,11.3]`
Chris: Can we hold ~10m? Running a load test now that exercises prefetch. If that looks green I'll give LGTM.
Talia: Happy to eyeball the diff now. Where is the test for empty inputs?
Maria: Added `tests/runtime/test_kv_zero_input.py` and a tiny smoke test in the PR. Run locally: ```pytest tests/runtime/test_kv_zero_input.py -q```
Sam: Left a small nit inline — prefer an early return to reduce nesting. Also, can we add a tiny unit for the TTL edge-case on the kv cache?
Maria: Good catch, Sam. Pushed a cleanup and a TTL unit test; CI kicked off.
DeployBot: CI pipeline started for PR #4821 — running checks: unit, integration, perf-smoke.
AJ: Thanks — I'll review after CI finishes. If green, +1 from me.
Chris: Load test finished: no regressions in our high-concurrency scenario. :shipit:
Talia: Reviewed, left one non-blocking comment. Approving after that tiny tweak.
Maria: Pushed Talia's tweak. Requesting merge window now (next 5–45m depending on traffic). Will monitor canary and rollback if anything odd.
Sam: LGTM once CI is green. :+1:
Maria: Merging in ~5m unless someone objects. Will watch canary and post results here. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
